question: What exalted attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment belongs to the yoginīs
The practitioner may become dear to them
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs, possessing the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
